pipeline.title: Roche pays Zymeworks $55M for trispecific challenger to Amgen’s Imdelltra
pipeline.summary: Roche is paying Zymeworks $55 million upfront for ZW209, bagging global rights to a trispecific designed to improve on the rate and depth of responses achieved by Amgen’s Imdelltra.

pipeline.title: Treasury sweeps biotech into proposed COINS Act restrictions, but spares Big Pharma’s China licensing deals

pipeline.summary: Celltrion has licensed a preclinical antibody targeting autoimmune conditions from Maryland-based biotech Kaigene in a deal worth up to $580.5 million, marking another step in the South Korean drugmaker's expansion beyond its traditional biosimilar business.

pipeline.summary: The PMCPA has ruled that Otsuka Europe’s involvement with a sponsored symposium webpage breached 11 clauses of the U.K. marketing code. While the PMCPA found fault with many aspects of the webpage, the watchdog opted against hitting Otsuka with its toughest punishment.

pipeline.summary: Eye specialty pharma Alcon has bought out Neurotech Pharmaceuticals for $550 million, gaining access to the approved Encelto and Neurotech's proprietary cell-based gene therapy delivery platform.
